title: PhD Public Defense of Ms. Aneela Akbar Conducted at Central Library (Garden Campus), AWKUM.
text:
A
PhD Public
Defense
was successfully conducted at
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
(AWKUM)
for
Ms. Aneela Akbar
, PhD Scholar, Department of Political
Science.

The defense
took place on
January 28, 2026
, at the
Conference Room, Central
Library (Garden Campus), AWKUM
.

During the
session, the scholar presented her PhD research titled:

“An Analysis of
the Impacts of Sit-ins on Parliamentary Democracy of Pakistan.”

The research
was completed under the supervision of
Prof. Dr. Zahir Shah
, Professor
and Pro-Vice Chancellor / Dean, Faculty of Social Sciences (DFSS).

The defense was
attended by a panel of internal and external examiners, along with faculty
members and research scholars. The presentation was followed by an interactive
question-and-answer session, during which the research methodology, findings,
and conclusions were thoroughly discussed.

The university
community appreciated the scholarly work and congratulated the scholar on this
important academic milestone.
